PLAN "12-week Post-Herniated Disc General Strength"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "General strength with spine-safe loading"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Foundation & Movement Quality" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Full-body A":
        warmup:
          bike 8m
          band_pull_aparts 2m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_rdl 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_dumbbell_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row_machine 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          farmer_carry 3x30s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_drill 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper emphasis":
        warmup:
          row 8m
          thoracic_rotation 2m
        main straight_sets:
          single_arm_dumbbell_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          chest_supported_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          plank_progression 3x30s rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec_mobility 5m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Lower & core":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 8m
          glute_bridge 2m
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          trap_bar_deadlift_light 3x5..6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          step_up 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x10 each rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Full-body A":
